name: alpha-sweep
airframe: Fighter1, Multirole1, SmallFighter1, trainer, VTOLTrainer1, EW1, FastBomber1, Darkreach
note: SUPERSEDED BY 'alpha-pullup' — DO NOT RE-FLY THIS FOR ALPHA DATA. Kept on disk only so R39's 61 captures keep their dimension row in index-captures.py --cards. It FAILED STRUCTURALLY, not by tuning: its demand is an AZIMUTH sweep derived from the airframe's structural g, so the roll/turn channel saturates first — all 60 scorable R39 segments railed on bank clamp (74-97%), turn-rate cap (85-97%) and blend rail (81-96%) while aoaAboveCeilingPct read 0.0 on 60 of 60, and the deficit was paid in 525-2428 m of DESCENT with q RISING 3-32%. See debugtests/R39-E-alpha.md and cards/ALPHA-CARD-REDESIGN.md. Original note follows. THE highest-value card: aoaLimiterActivePct is 0 in every capture ever taken. Same stimulus shape as fixedwing-sweep (deriveAzRate = 0.6 of the airframe's own instantaneous rate, i.e. a fixed fraction of ITS structural g), flown at 8000 m instead of 4000. Thin air means that fraction is no longer available aerodynamically, so the wing rides its alpha ceiling and stays there as energy bleeds. Pass = aoaAboveCeilingPct > 0 on alphaHold; 0 means the card failed to reach the regime, not that the law is clean. AIRFRAME: the eight fixed-wing keys that clear the v0.92 envelope gate (1.10x Vstall .. 0.95x Vmax) at this card's 250 m/s - CAS1 (0.95x Vmax = 195.3), COIN (134.6) and all three rotorcraft would be refused pre-spawn. deriveAzRate makes the demand a fraction of EACH lane's own capability, so the eight are asking one question rather than eight, and the 5.0 gLimit airframes (FastBomber1, Darkreach) are the ones most likely to hit alpha before g - which is the regime this card exists to find. It does NOT cover the loaded case - a card cannot set a loadout - so fly it again by hand with heavy stores. CARD-OWNED VALUES (v1.0.3): Drone/DroneAltDeckM = 0 - corpus: this card last flew in R39 (v0.98.1), before Drone/DroneAltDeckM existed (v0.99), so every lane flew one deck. corpus: R39 flew this card at thr 1.000 on every row, not the 0.70 shipped default.
